definitions.explanation: The act of doing something in place of another person.
A person who acts in place of another.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}の{代理|だいり}で{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: I attended the meeting on behalf of the president.

examples.japanese: {代理人|だいりにん}を{立|た}てる。
{母親|ははおや}が{代理|だいり}で{手続|てつづ}きをした。
examples.english: My mother did the procedures on my behalf.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {代理人|だいりにん} (agent, proxy, representative)
- {代理店|だいりてん} (agency, dealership)
- {代理出産|だいりしゅっさん} (surrogate birth)
- {代理母|だいりはは} (surrogate mother)

GRAMMAR:
- 〜の{代理|だいり}で: on behalf of ~, in place of ~
- {代理|だいり}を{務|つと}める: to serve as a substitute

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代理|だいり}: Proxy, acting on behalf (formal delegation)
- {代|か}わり: Substitute, replacement (more casual)
